palo-alto-precision-ai.training_optout: Palo Alto's data terms govern threat telemetry sharing, which is standard for threat intelligence. XSIAM case data terms require separate review.

microsoft-live-captions.name: Microsoft PowerPoint and Teams live captions
microsoft-live-captions.value: PowerPoint shows live subtitles in the speaker's or a translated language while presenting, and Teams captions meetings with translation on premium plans, both built on Azure speech. They are standard accessibility features in schools and offices.

pricing.includes: Captions; translated Teams captions need premium

microsoft-live-captions.tagline: Real time captions and subtitles in PowerPoint presentations and Teams meetings, with translation into many languages.
microsoft-live-captions.catalog_name: Microsoft PowerPoint and Teams live captions
microsoft-live-captions.governance_note: Teams transcripts, if saved, are records; captions alone are not retained.
microsoft-live-captions.training_optout: Microsoft 365 data is not used for training.

cons: Speech recognition errors with young readers
microsoft-reading-coach.name: Microsoft Reading Coach
microsoft-reading-coach.value: Reading Coach uses speech recognition to hear students read aloud, identifies words to practise and generates personalised stories with AI, free as a standalone app and inside Teams for Education and Immersive Reader. It extends Microsoft's Reading Progress tool.
microsoft-reading-coach.engine: Azure speech with generative story models.
microsoft-reading-coach.tagline: AI reading practice that listens to students read, gives pronunciation feedback and generates stories at their level.
microsoft-reading-coach.governance_note: Student voice recordings are processed under Microsoft education terms; the teacher assigned version keeps data in the tenant.
microsoft-reading-coach.training_optout: Education data is not used for training.

github-copilot-education.name: GitHub Copilot for Education
github-copilot-education.value: GitHub Education gives verified students and teachers Copilot Pro free, alongside GitHub Classroom for assignments and Codespaces for cloud development, which puts the leading coding assistant in every computer science course. Teachers decide how it is used in assessment.
github-copilot-education.tagline: Free Copilot Pro for verified students and teachers through GitHub Education, with classroom and Codespaces tools.
github-copilot-education.governance_note: Course policies should say when Copilot may be used; GitHub's education terms exclude training on student code.
github-copilot-education.training_optout: Copilot does not train on user code under GitHub's terms.

google-teachable-machine.name: Google Teachable Machine
google-teachable-machine.value: Teachable Machine trains small models in the browser from webcam, microphone or uploaded examples and exports them to TensorFlow, which makes it the standard classroom demonstration of supervised learning. It is free and needs no account.
google-teachable-machine.tagline: Browser tool that lets anyone train an image, sound or pose classifier in minutes, for teaching how machine learning works.
google-teachable-machine.governance_note: Data stays in the browser unless exported; ideal for lessons on bias because students see it happen.

servicenow-ai-governance.name: ServiceNow AI Governance
servicenow-ai-governance.value: ServiceNow extended its risk and workflow platform into AI governance with an AI Control Tower that inventories models and agents, assesses risk, enforces policies and monitors usage, including its own Now Assist agents. It fits companies that run risk and IT on ServiceNow.
servicenow-ai-governance.tagline: ServiceNow's AI Control Tower for inventorying, governing and monitoring AI agents and models across the enterprise.
use_cases: Risk workflow for AI use cases
servicenow-ai-governance.governance_note: Governing agents as well as models is the right scope in 2026; use it to register every agent with its permissions.
servicenow-ai-governance.training_optout: ServiceNow does not train on customer data.

hugging-face-transformers.name: Hugging Face Transformers
hugging-face-transformers.value: Transformers is the Python library through which most open models are loaded, fine tuned and run, and the Hugging Face Hub is where they are published, with datasets, Spaces demos and inference services around it. It is the infrastructure of open AI.
hugging-face-transformers.engine: Library and hub for every open model.
hugging-face-transformers.tagline: The open source library that made pretrained models usable, and the hub of hundreds of thousands of models around it.
use_cases: Loading and fine tuning open models
hugging-face-transformers.governance_note: Downloaded models can carry malicious code or restrictive licences; use safetensors, pin versions and record licences. Enterprise Hub adds access control and audit.
hugging-face-transformers.training_optout: Not applicable to the library; hub terms for uploads.

machine-learning-for-kids.name: Machine Learning for Kids
machine-learning-for-kids.value: Built by an IBM engineer as a side project, Machine Learning for Kids walks students through collecting data, training a model and using it in a Scratch game, with teacher worksheets, and is free worldwide. It is a staple of AI literacy lessons.
machine-learning-for-kids.engine: Cloud ML services and in browser training.
machine-learning-for-kids.tagline: Free platform where students train text, image and number models and use them in Scratch, Python and App Inventor.
machine-learning-for-kids.governance_note: Teacher creates class accounts; no student personal data is required.

microsoft-agent-framework.api: Library, with a hosted agent service in Azure AI Foundry.
cons: Concepts to learn for anyone coming from plain SDK calls
microsoft-agent-framework.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
pros: One supported path for .NET and Python shops
Observability and durable workflows out of the box
Native MCP and Azure identity integration
microsoft-agent-framework.files: Through tools and connectors you attach.
microsoft-agent-framework.value: The Agent Framework merges Semantic Kernel's enterprise plumbing with AutoGen's multi agent patterns into one supported SDK, with graph based workflows, built in observability and first class support for Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI and the Model Context Protocol. It is the framework Microsoft now points enterprises at.
microsoft-agent-framework.engine: Any model through its connectors; Azure AI Foundry is the native home.
microsoft-agent-framework.quality: Well engineered; the enterprise plumbing is the reason to choose it.
microsoft-agent-framework.tagline: Microsoft's unified SDK for building agents and multi agent workflows in .NET and Python, the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen.
use_cases: Enterprise agents with Entra identity and audit trails
Multi step workflows that must survive restarts
Migrating Semantic Kernel or AutoGen code
microsoft-agent-framework.governance_note: The framework ships the controls a governance review asks for: identity on every agent, tracing of every tool call, durable state. Using them is a design choice, not a default, so write them into the build standard.
microsoft-agent-framework.training_optout: Open source; model calls follow Azure OpenAI or the chosen vendor's terms, which exclude training on customer data for Azure.

pcd-portable-context-deck.api: A remote MCP endpoint at https://mcp.portablecontext.ai/mcp over streamable HTTP, authenticated with OAuth 2.0 and PKCE. No API key is issued; sign-in happens on first connect. A web dashboard at app.portablecontext.ai manages containers and connections.
cons: Early access at v0.4, with signup released in controlled batches
Free but capped during early access, and the terms reserve the right to introduce a price with notice, so long-run cost is unknown
Operated by an individual rather than a disclosed company, which is a continuity risk no policy text resolves
The repository is a source snapshot, not a runnable self-hosted distribution, so the open licence does not currently deliver an exit
Only works with clients that support custom MCP connections
pcd-portable-context-deck.name: PCD (Portable Context Deck)
pros: One endpoint serves every MCP-capable client, so context is not locked to a single assistant
Export to JSON and Markdown means the deck is not trapped in the service
Public core is published under AGPL-3.0, so the mechanism is inspectable
pcd-portable-context-deck.files: Containers the vendor calls preferences, traits, skills, work, knowledge, history, specialists and connections. The knowledge container is described as queryable and scoped to the deck. Changes are versioned and committed, and decks export to JSON and Markdown.
pcd-portable-context-deck.value: Keeps the context you would otherwise re-explain at the start of every AI session in one deck, reachable over a single Model Context Protocol endpoint. A client connects, loads the deck, and starts with your preferences, standing guidelines, saved procedures, live work state and knowledge base already in place. The point is portability: the same deck is available in whichever assistant, IDE or chat client you are working in that day.
pcd-portable-context-deck.engine: None of its own. PCD carries context to whichever model the connected client is running; it is a context layer, not a model.

pricing.limits: Capped usage; signup released in controlled batches
pricing.includes: Full product setup: MCP endpoint, dashboard, connection management, and export

pcd-portable-context-deck.tagline: A portable context layer that loads your preferences, work state and knowledge into any MCP-capable AI client.
use_cases: Carrying one working context across several AI clients rather than re-briefing each
Resuming a project days later without re-establishing what was in progress
Giving domain-scoped specialists a shared base of context and skills
integrations: Any client supporting custom Model Context Protocol connections
Client-connected connectors reached through the deck
pcd-portable-context-deck.governance_note: A portable context layer concentrates in one place the material a person would otherwise spread across separate assistants: standing instructions, work in progress, and an accumulated knowledge base. That concentration is the product, and it is also the risk, because a single credential then reaches all of it. The published terms and privacy policy answer more of the usual questions than most services at this stage. PCD is operated by Andrea Dellanoce in Belgium, named as the data controller, with Belgian law applying and the Belgian Data Protection Authority named as the supervisory route for complaints. The privacy policy lists its processors, Cloudflare, Supabase, Resend, and Sampark Inc trading as Composio, with transfer bases stated, and gives server-log retention as seven days. The policy states that private context is not sold and not used to train or fine-tune a model, and decks export to JSON and Markdown. The minimum age is 16. What remains open is the shape of the operator: a service run by a named individual rather than an incorporated entity carries continuity risk that no policy text addresses, so the export path is the control that matters most here.
pcd-portable-context-deck.training_optout: The privacy policy states that private context is not sold and is not used to train or fine-tune a model. Processors are listed with transfer bases, and server logs are kept for seven days.

microsoft-immersive-reader.name: Microsoft Immersive Reader
microsoft-immersive-reader.value: Immersive Reader appears across Word, OneNote, Teams, Edge and partner apps, offering text to speech, grammar highlighting, line focus and translation, and is used widely for dyslexia and language learner support. Its AI parts are speech and translation rather than generation.
microsoft-immersive-reader.tagline: Reading support built into Microsoft products: read aloud, text spacing, syllables, picture dictionary and translation.
microsoft-immersive-reader.governance_note: Microsoft education terms apply; no student data concerns beyond the host product.

adobe-express-for-education.name: Adobe Express for Education
adobe-express-for-education.value: Adobe Express for Education gives schools the quick design tool with Firefly image and text effects, classroom templates and safeguards, free with Adobe's education data terms. It competes with Canva for Education.
adobe-express-for-education.tagline: Free Adobe Express for K12 with Firefly generation and safe search settings for students.
adobe-express-for-education.governance_note: Firefly's training data story makes it the safer generator for student work under copyright questions.
adobe-express-for-education.training_optout: Adobe does not train on education user content.

microsoft-power-automate-ai.api: Power Platform API; connectors for external systems.
cons: AI automations can be built by any user without approval
AI Builder credits are a separate cost
Complexity scales quickly beyond basic document processing
microsoft-power-automate-ai.name: Microsoft Power Automate AI
pros: Already licensed for most M365 organizations
No-code flow building with Copilot assistance
Stays within the M365 compliance boundary
microsoft-power-automate-ai.files: M365 documents, forms, emails, and structured data in SharePoint and Dataverse.
microsoft-power-automate-ai.value: AI automation capabilities inside Power Automate, the automation layer that ships with Microsoft 365. AI Builder adds document parsing, form processing, prediction, and Copilot-assisted flow creation. The relevant point is that it is already in the M365 licence for many organizations.
microsoft-power-automate-ai.engine: Azure AI services (Form Recognizer, prediction models) plus Copilot for flow authoring.

pricing.model: Per flow run or per capacity unit for AI Builder
pricing.includes: Basic automation; AI Builder requires additional credits

microsoft-power-automate-ai.quality: Strong for M365-native document and data workflows. Less general than Zapier but deeper inside the M365 boundary.
microsoft-power-automate-ai.tagline: AI-powered automation inside the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, with no-code access.
use_cases: Document and form extraction at scale from invoices, contracts, and forms
Building no-code automations with natural language in an M365 environment
AI-powered approval and routing workflows over M365 data
integrations: All Microsoft 365 services: SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dynamics
microsoft-power-automate-ai.governance_note: Power Automate is the automation layer most M365 organizations already have but rarely inventory. The governance gap is that any M365 user can build and run automations, including AI automations via AI Builder, without IT approval. A process that was manually reviewed yesterday can be automated today without any change record. The control requirement is an automation inventory and approval workflow, not just policy: automations that touch sensitive data or make business decisions need the same change management as any other system change.
microsoft-power-automate-ai.training_optout: Microsoft's commercial data terms apply. AI Builder processing stays within the Azure tenant.

microsoft-word-transcription.name: Microsoft Word transcription
microsoft-word-transcription.value: Word's Transcribe feature turns recordings or uploads into transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps, inside Word for the web and desktop, included with Microsoft 365. Students and staff use it for lectures and interviews.
microsoft-word-transcription.tagline: Transcribe in Word: record or upload audio and get a speaker labelled transcript inside the document.
microsoft-word-transcription.governance_note: Recording others needs consent; transcripts stored in OneDrive follow tenant retention.
microsoft-word-transcription.training_optout: Microsoft 365 data is not used for training.

microsoft-powerpoint-designer.name: Microsoft PowerPoint Designer
microsoft-powerpoint-designer.value: Designer watches what you put on a slide and proposes professional layouts, icons and image treatments, which lets teachers and students make clean slides without design skills. Copilot has extended it with full deck generation.
microsoft-powerpoint-designer.tagline: Design Ideas in PowerPoint that suggest layouts and visuals for a slide automatically.
microsoft-powerpoint-designer.training_optout: Microsoft 365 data is not used for training.

microsoft-copilot-chat-education.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for Education
microsoft-copilot-chat-education.value: Education tenants get Copilot Chat with enterprise data protection for staff and eligible students at no cost, with paid Microsoft 365 Copilot adding access to tenant data, and admin controls by age. It is the Microsoft counterpart to Gemini for Education.
microsoft-copilot-chat-education.engine: Microsoft Copilot over OpenAI and Microsoft models.

pricing.includes: Copilot in apps with tenant data

microsoft-copilot-chat-education.tagline: Secure Copilot Chat for education tenants with enterprise data protection, and Copilot licences for staff and students 13 and over.
microsoft-copilot-chat-education.governance_note: Student access is an admin decision by age group; enterprise data protection covers prompts and responses.
microsoft-copilot-chat-education.training_optout: Education tenant data is not used for training.
